title: Exploring Streptococcus pneumoniae capsular typing through MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry and machine-learning algorithms in Argentina: Identifying prevalent NON PCV13 serotypes alongside PCV13 serotypes.
summary: full text confirms learned mass-spectrum classification tested on 215 surveillance isolates against Quellung typing; low sensitivity/specificity and possible overfit limit usefulness but are themselves a measured field evaluation. AI role: Machine-learning classifiers applied to MALDI-TOF mass spectra. The article appeared in Journal Of Mass Spectrometry And Advances In The Clinical Lab.
